backup-messages.export-description: Downloads a .json file with your own categories, the settings of each category, all your movements (expenses, incomes and savings) and your groups. Use it to keep a copy or to move your data into another account.
backup-messages.import-description: Choose a backup (.json) created in the block above, from this or another account. Before saving it shows what will be copied: own categories, category settings, movements and groups.
backup-messages.import-again: Importing the same file again does not duplicate anything: it replaces what the previous import brought.
backup-messages.invalid-file: The file is not a MyMoney backup or it is damaged.
backup-messages.newer-version: The backup was created with a newer version of MyMoney. Update the app and try again.
backup-messages.without-category: {{count}} movements have a category that does not exist in this account: they are imported anyway, but they will show without a category.
backup-messages.overwrite-hint: Movements that already exist with the same id, and the groups and category settings of this account, are replaced by the ones in the file.
backup-messages.confirm-message: Do you want to copy the backup into this account? It may take a few minutes.
backup-messages.my-events-description: Creates the file that my-events imports, with the incomes and expenses of the chosen range and their groups. It cannot be imported into MyMoney: use the backup for that.
